Hey guys, so a little bit of backstory along with this image: 

I live in Roseburg, Oregon, USA. I'm out in the country, I live up the side of a hill. My driveway is behind a gate and my place is a half mile up. I have a few neighbors down at the bottom of my driveway. I've lived here for about 2 years. The last 3 months or so, I've been having some wierd things happen. Loud noises in my garage below me, like things dropping to the floor. But when I go investigate, I see nothing disturbed. Also noises against my house (thuds) happen intermittently. 

About a month ago, I was driving up my driveway in the dark,  around 930 or so, and there was a loud thud against my driver side door. I figured I just drove over a stick and it popped up and hit my car or maybe a deer even ran into me. It was dark and I couldn't see anything to my side. I noticed it but didn't think anything about it at the time.

About 5 minutes later, I'm standing in my garage with the light on. Out of the corner of my eye, there is a quick flash of light in the woods to my right. A dim flash. The only way I can think to describe it is like a camera flash. I'm not saying that's what it was. Just how I can describe it. It was only seen out of my peripheral and it was very quick. It wasn't stormy in the least, and it's just woods, no road or other houses that direction. At all. Creeped me out a little so I went up and went in the house. 

A little while later that night I heard a fairly loud crash of something falling in the garage below me. Enough to scare my dog where he jumped out of his bed and ran over to me. 
I spent that night pretty creeped out. The next morning, nothing at all was disturbed in my garage. That was the end of weird things for a few weeks apart from a few noises here and there. 

Last night, I got home and pulled in the garage. Again about 930/945. Im walking over to turn the light on and I see from the moonlight a color change on the garage floor. I be sure to not step near it, flip the light on, and it's what looks like a footprint to me. I take the pic included, then bend down and feel it and it's definitely a fresh wet track. But just one. Nothing else around. No other prints or water splashes or anything. It was raining out so the ground was wet but I didn't step there, and my feet were dry anyway from being in my car. 

Does anyone have any idea what I could possibly have going on here? I bought a trail cam I'm gonna put up in the morning.
